companyDescription: Superconducting full-stack quantum computers · First European quantum company on a major US exchange (Nasdaq Jul 2, 2026) · 26 systems sold worldwide · €102M+ order backlog · Production Quantum on-premises model for research, government & enterprise
priceNote: Trading near its 52-week low ($9.18), down from the $12.50 level of the last check — now below the SPAC's own $10 PIPE-floor stop level, a threshold the prior report itself called 'listing thesis broken.' Genuinely good Q2 2026 results landed yesterday (Aug 4) and the stock still fell — a real, persistent distrust pattern, not a fundamentals problem.
summary: IQM reported its first results as a US-listed public company yesterday (Aug 4): H1 2026 revenue of €8.9M at a 46% gross margin, order backlog up sharply to €102.1M (from €69.1M at Jun 30, from €67M at the last check), and a new government-linked contract — Finland's LUMI AI Factory selected IQM to deploy a Halocene H4 quantum system by 2027, worth roughly a full year of 2025 revenue. FY26 guidance calls for €65-75M in new order intake and €42-47M revenue. Despite all of that, the stock fell -3.45% on the news and now sits at its 52-week low, already below the $10 SPAC PIPE-floor level the last report flagged as a thesis-break threshold — the market's skepticism about post-SPAC quantum names is outweighing genuinely improving fundamentals for now. The real remaining binary — a US/EU government quantum-equity award, the kind that sent RGTI/QBTS/Infleqtion up 30%+ in May 2026 — is still unconfirmed and undated.

catalysts.name: US/EU Government Quantum Contract Wave
catalysts.description: IQMX was excluded from the May 2026 $2B US Commerce Dept quantum equity round that sent RGTI/QBTS/Infleqtion up 30%+ in a single day. The LUMI AI Factory deal (Finland, by 2027) is a real government-adjacent win but smaller and EU-based — a genuine US CHIPS/NATO-style award is still the binary moonshot catalyst, still unconfirmed.

catalysts.name: Fault-Tolerant Roadmap Milestone
catalysts.description: IQM is deploying proceeds toward fault-tolerant quantum computing. A demonstrated error-correction or qubit-scaling milestone would differentiate IQM from pre-revenue quantum SPACs and justify a peer-multiple re-rating.

catalysts.name: FY2026 Guidance Delivery
catalysts.description: Management guided €65-75M new order intake and €42-47M FY26 revenue at the Aug 4 print — the next checkpoint is whether Q3/H2 results track toward that range, which would test whether yesterday's negative price reaction was overdone.

risks: The stock fell -3.45% on Aug 4 despite genuinely good Q2 results (backlog +48% to €102M, 46% gross margin, new LUMI government-linked contract) — a real, persistent negative-sentiment pattern that isn't fixed by fundamentals alone

Already trading below the $10 SPAC PIPE-floor level that the prior report's own framework called 'listing thesis broken' — this isn't a hypothetical technical stop anymore, it's the current price, meaning the stock is now trading on pure sentiment/momentum rather than a clean technical support
Continued warrant/dilution overhang — Kreos Capital exercised 577,237 new shares on Jul 16, 2026, and further warrant exercises remain a live dilution risk
The US government quantum-equity round (the real binary moonshot catalyst) already passed IQMX over once in May 2026 — no guarantee of inclusion in any future round
Net loss is deepening (-$63.86M TTM) — cash burn is real even though the ~€270M+ remaining balance implies a long runway

th.summary: IQM รายงานผลครั้งแรกในฐานะบริษัทมหาชนในสหรัฐฯ เมื่อวานนี้ (4 ส.ค.) — รายได้ H1 2026 €8.9M กำไรขั้นต้น 46% backlog พุ่งขึ้นเป็น €102.1M (จาก €69.1M ณ 30 มิ.ย. จาก €67M ในเช็คครั้งก่อน) และมีสัญญาใหม่เชื่อมโยงภาครัฐ — LUMI AI Factory ของฟินแลนด์เลือก IQM ติดตั้งระบบควอนตัม Halocene H4 ภายในปี 2027 มูลค่าราวเท่ารายได้ทั้งปี 2025 FY26 guide คือ order intake €65-75M รายได้ €42-47M แม้จะมีข่าวดีทั้งหมดนี้ หุ้นกลับลง -3.45% และตอนนี้อยู่ที่ 52-week low แล้ว ต่ำกว่าระดับ $10 SPAC PIPE-floor ที่รายงานครั้งก่อนเรียกว่า 'thesis พัง' ไปแล้ว — ความสงสัยของตลาดต่อหุ้น quantum หลัง SPAC ยังมีน้ำหนักมากกว่าพื้นฐานที่ดีขึ้นจริงตอนนี้ catalyst ตัวจริงที่เหลืออยู่ — สัญญาภาครัฐสหรัฐ/EU แบบที่เคยส่ง RGTI/QBTS/Infleqtion ขึ้น 30%+ ในเดือนพ.ค. 2026 — ยังไม่ยืนยันและไม่มีวันที่แน่นอน
